about_short_description.short_description: Bapco Energies is an oil and gas holding company that specializes in energy investment and development.

product.name: Bapco Upstream
product.description: Responsible for exploration, field development, production, and distribution of oil and gas in Bahrain.

product.name: Bapco Refining
product.description: Operates refining capabilities including the Bapco Modernization Programme (BMP) to upgrade the Sitra refinery.

product.name: Bapco Gas
product.description: Handles oil production, gas treatment, and extraction of propane, butane, and naphtha for local industries.

product.name: Bapco Gas Expansion
product.description: Focuses on processing, storage, and distribution of propane, butane, and naphtha from the Bahrain Oil Field.

product.name: Bapco Tazweed
product.description: Manages the national infrastructure of service stations and their services.

product.name: Bapco Air Fueling
product.description: Handles aviation refueling at Bahrain International Airport.
